title: JCraft Additions
description: Enhances JCraft with custom skins, new mechanics, and content for addons.
body:
# JCraft Additions 1.1.1 Update!

This mod features custom skins created by your new favorite authors: Cinar4680, iron2099, NachoBruzoni, Peepo, ramtomer, Rec0rd, Subsetgaming, SvenTorhavich, and Truflie.


JCraft Additions has received a massive content update with features such as **NEW** custom skins, stand disc storage, an entire new wood variant, and a new stand!


This mod features custom skins created by your new favorite authors: Cinar4680, iron2099, NachoBruzoni, Peepo, ramtomer, Rec0rd, Subsetgaming, SvenTorhavich, and Truflie.


**Cheap Trick** - Obtaining Cheap Trick is comparable to a curse; because if someone looks at your back, he will kill you and transfer to the person who looked. He can be killed in various ways by a few different stands who have powerful abilities. Examples; can be killed during stopped time, shot by Tusk's nails, or erased by The Hand. 

**Cinderella's Kiss IV** - Using this new level of enchantment on a _Cinderella's Mask_ will open a menu on use. When used with no stand, it will show all available skins for all stands. In this big menu, you can filter which stand you want to see and what author whose work you want to see.

When used with a stand, it will show you all skins which that specific stand has. Some stands may not have skins yet, but more will be added. Or if you have skins of your own that you want to see in this mod, then visit my Ko-Fi and send them!


**Stand Disc Pouch** - Lets you put up to 5 stand discs into the inventory of this. Left clicking will move a disc in and out of your inventory, and right clicking will use the disc and swap whatever stand you have equipped into that slot. 


**Locacaca** - Adds a new green wood variant, fruit, and plant. Locacaca Trees can be found in jungles and lush caves and will spawn with Locacaca plants attached to it; these plants will eventually grow into a fruit.


**Locacaca Fruits** - These currently have the ability to transfer 5 health to 5 hunger and vise versa. Locacaca Fruits will eventually be able to be used with a stand to obtain another one...


**Golden Stand Disc** - A texture that represents your stand has a custom skin from JCraft Additions on it.


**The Cheap Trick model was made by NachoBruzoni**


Want to see your own skin in this mod? visit my Ko-Fi!

This mod allows for

Public skins

Private skins (usable ONLY by players who are specified, but visible to everybody still.)
